spans.s:
अन्-, before consonants अऽ अ-, an inseparable prefix, implying
 I. negation, e. g. अ-ब्राह्मण, m. One who is not a Brāhmaṇa,
. In this use it produces very often the opposite signification, e. g. अ-गद, m. Health,

.
 II. deterioration.
 1. Wrong, e. g. अ-काल, m. Unseasonable time,

. []
 2. Bad, अ-क्स्केत्र, n. A bad field,

.
 --Cf. Lat. in-; Goth. and A.S. un-; ἀν- and ἀ-.

अन्, ii. 1, Par. † i. 4, Ātm.
 1. To breathe.
 2. To blow (as wind).
 3. To live.
 --Cf. ἄνεμος; Lat. animus, ânus (cf. Sskr. अपान); Goth. uz-ana; see प्रान.
